tldr: AI assistants are the dominant front in retail banking right now, with BMO, Wealthsimple and Chime all shipping in-app agents, while Canadian savings-rate and credit-card promos stay aggressive and LatAm players push cross-border and crypto changes.

highlights.headline: Wealthsimple unveils Penny AI assistant and Wealthsimple Pay ($100k instant transfers)
highlights.why: A direct Canadian competitor is bundling AI + fast P2P — pressure on Simplii's everyday-banking value prop.

highlights.headline: BMO launches in-app AI agent for credit-card support
highlights.why: Big-Five rival setting a new bar for self-serve support; worth benchmarking against Simplii's flows.

highlights.headline: RBC overhauls Cash Back Mastercard with $1 redemption minimum
highlights.why: Low-friction rewards redemption is becoming table stakes in the Canadian card market.
